what: On 2026-10-15 swarm update 1.62.0 to 1.65.0 did not create ~/.local/bin/swarm or the completion file. updateInstall runs inside the old process, whose already-loaded install.mjs ran, so install steps added by the new release never ran on the update that introduced them. Running node tools/install.mjs --user afterwards fixed it.
rule: An updater must run the installer of the version it installs, in a fresh process, not the code already loaded.
fix: In the next phase PR: after checking out the new tag, run node <root>/tools/install.mjs --user in a child process and report its result; add a test that update from an older fixture install creates the swarm command.
